# Actions this repository is allowed to run.
#
# This file is the source of truth for Settings > Actions > General > "Allow specified actions",
# which is not otherwise under version control. GitHub-owned actions are not allowed by default
# there, so actions/* entries are listed here too.
#
# One entry per line: owner/repo[/path]@<full commit SHA>, optionally followed by "# <tag>".
# Pin the commit SHA, not the SHA of an annotated tag object.
#
# - .github/scripts/check-allowed-actions.sh (allowed-actions workflow) fails a PR that uses an
#   action not listed here.
# - .github/scripts/sync-allowed-actions.sh applies this file to the repository setting. It
#   needs repository admin, so a maintainer runs it by hand.
#
# Entries must cover every branch whose workflows still run, not only main.
